sources.entry: SystemEQ for Mac - Free, open-source system-wide parametric equalizer with AutoEQ presets, hearing calibration, and real-time visualization. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/denzam/SystemEQ-for-Mac) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: SystemEQ for Mac
summary.one_liner: A free, open-source system-wide parametric equalizer for macOS 13+ with AutoEQ headphone presets, hearing calibration, room tuning and a MilkDrop visualizer.
use_cases: Equalize headphones with AutoEQ presets on a Mac
Correct room resonances with a sine sweep and notch filters
Tune audio for personal hearing with ear-based calibration
Apply system-wide EQ to all app audio on macOS
Remember a different EQ preset per output device
summary.what_it_does: SystemEQ is a macOS app that applies a parametric equalizer to all system audio, offering a 10-band or 31-band mode. It includes a database of over 8,850 AutoEQ presets for headphones and can import .txt preset files. Calibration tools cover ear-based hearing compensation, manual frequency tests, and an automatic sine sweep to find booming or ringing frequencies, with notch filters to address them. Audio is captured natively on macOS 14.4+ or via BlackHole on older versions, processed with vDSP biquad filters, and sent to the chosen physical output. A MilkDrop-style visualizer reacts to audio, and the interface is available in English, Italian and Ukrainian.
notable: Native system-audio capture (Process Tap) on macOS 14.4+, no driver needed
Automatic sine sweep to find and notch room or headphone resonances
Developer ID signed and Apple-notarized releases from v1.4.6
No app telemetry; installs via GitHub Releases or Homebrew tap
caveats: Requires macOS 13 or newer; BlackHole driver needed on macOS 13–14.3 and for fallback or BlackHole mode
Older releases through v1.4.4 and local builds may use ad-hoc signing
